verdict.rationale: A runtime probe checked against official docs reports that Godot ships a built-in GDScript language server that external editors or agent tooling can attach to. The official godotengine/godot-vscode-plugin (2,130 stars, actively pushed) is a first-party client for it, and the docs confirm external editors such as VS Code are supported. Missing for 10: first-party LSP documentation detailing completions, diagnostics and navigation; hands-on or independent corroboration of LSP quality; evidence of typed API definitions or tooling for C#.
